description: Allowlist of outbound destinations and telemetry/cloud-fallback surfaces for the sysadmin AI platform. Every external destination found in the scanned tree MUST map to one entry here; an external host in runtime code that matches no entry makes `egress_audit.py` exit non-zero. `control_tokens` are the literal switch/env-var names searched for in the scanned code to decide whether the disable mechanism is already present.

classes.install-time: Artifact download that happens during install.sh / install-harness.sh; requires a mirror in a blocked-egress environment.
classes.runtime-local: Loopback / localhost / internal service address; no public egress.
classes.runtime-external: Reachable from service code at runtime; must be disabled or routed through a controlled import.

destinations.name: HuggingFace Hub (model download)
destinations.note: snapshot_download/hf_hub_download in model_manager/downloader.py. Controlled import: the admin API triggers an intentional download. The downloader already documents HF_ENDPOINT (mirror) and HF_HOME; HF_HUB_OFFLINE is honoured natively by huggingface_hub.

destinations.name: HuggingFace Hub telemetry
destinations.note: huggingface_hub sends anonymous usage events unless disabled. Not set anywhere in the platform; the operator must export it in the service environment (or the platform should set it when spawning downloads).

destinations.name: vLLM usage stats
destinations.note: vllm_server.py spawns `vllm serve` (via _default_popen) without disabling vLLM's usage-stats collector. The switch exists in vLLM but is NOT set by our supervisor; this is the one runtime-external destination lacking a disable switch in code.

destinations.name: LiteLLM telemetry
destinations.note: backend/config/litellm/config.yaml already sets `telemetry: false`. Callbacks are pinned to the local auth_gateway handler, not a cloud sink.

destinations.name: DeepSeek Harness LLM endpoint
destinations.note: The harness profile (cordis.patch.yml) and plugin default the LLM base URL to the LOCAL LiteLLM proxy, not api.deepseek.com.

destinations.name: DeepSeek Harness telemetry
destinations.note: gateway/instance-manager.js sets DSH_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 on every harness spawn; verify-harness.mjs sets it too. Harness telemetry is disabled in code.

destinations.name: Mila branding link
destinations.note: Served as an <a href> in gateway HTML/CSS only; no automatic fetch, so no runtime data egress. Safe under blocked egress (browser-side, user-initiated).

destinations.name: npm registry / DeepSeek Harness packages
destinations.control: npm registry mirror + NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1 + npmrc audit=false fund=false update-notifier=false
destinations.note: dsh CLI and @deepseek-ai/* bundles are fetched from the npm registry during install-harness.sh. Runtime imports resolve to the locally staged node_modules tree. npm/update-notifier telemetry is NOT disabled in code (install-time gap).

destinations.name: PyPI (Python packages)
destinations.control: PIP_INDEX_URL=<internal mirror> + PIP_NO_INDEX for fully offline
destinations.note: install.sh runs pip install litellm[proxy] fastapi uvicorn httpx pyyaml redis pydantic huggingface_hub. Needs an internal PyPI mirror; PIP_INDEX_URL is not set in code.

destinations.name: GitHub release (Traefik)
destinations.note: install.sh downloads the Traefik static binary.

destinations.name: GitHub release (VictoriaLogs)
destinations.note: install.sh downloads the VictoriaLogs static binary.

destinations.name: GitHub release (SeaweedFS)
destinations.note: install.sh downloads the SeaweedFS static binary.

destinations.name: Valkey (download.valkey.io / Homebrew fallback)
destinations.control: static binary mirror (pin + sha256, vendored into backend/bin) or distro package mirror
destinations.note: install.sh resolves Valkey from PATH/Linuxbrew first, then downloads the sha256-verified prebuilt tarball from download.valkey.io, with apt/apk package fallbacks; a blocked-egress host should vendor the tarball or install valkey-server from the distro mirror.
